mapper.select: SELECT check_list_id, title, created_at, u1.user_name as create_user_name, modified_at, u2.user_name as modify_user_name FROM check_list LEFT OUTER JOIN users u1 on check_list.created_by = u1.user_seq LEFT OUTER JOIN users u2 on check_list.created_by = u2.user_seq
SELECT check_list_id, title, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by FROM check_list WHERE check_list_id = #{checkListId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_list ( check_list_id, title, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{checkListId}, #{title}, now(), #{createdBy}, now(), #{modifiedBy} )
